AN ORIGINAL JURASSIC ENGLISH STORY

The Last Seat on the Night Ferry

Level 3 · Expansion

Ages 10–12

Story + Workbook

JurassicEnglish.com · Storybook workbook edition

Chapter 1

A ticket for a seat

1

Sela’s grandfather had worked on the night ferry for thirty-one years. On
its final evening, he gave her a ticket with a round hole punched through
the corner.
‘Window seat,’ he said.
Sela had made a sign: KEEP OUR FERRY. She folded it small enough to fit
in her coat.
A new daytime service would begin the next week, with a different
landing and easier boarding. The old boat needed repairs the town could
not fund.
Sela knew these facts. Knowing them did not make her want to climb
aboard for the last time.
Read and circle
Which reason for ending the old night ferry is given in this scene?
A. Grandfather was retiring after thirty-one years of work
B. The town had no money for the repairs it needed
C. Hardly anyone travelled on it after dark
